description: Calculate the cost of purchasing TRON Energy or Bandwidth. Provide transaction count and type to get the energy needed and cost in TRX.

resourceAmount.description: Exact resource amount; otherwise derived from transaction count.

targetAddress.description: TRON target address. Required for an executable market quote.

txType.description: Transaction type (default: trc20_transfer). trc20_transfer_new = first-time transfer to an address.
